title: crataegus pedicellata var. caesa
intro: Crataegus pedicellata var. caesa, commonly known as the Himalayan hawthorn, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of the Himalayan hawthorn include vasodilation, antioxidant activity, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
